text: I feel a mix of curiosity and anticipation. The first room, with its meeting setup and empty seats, suggests a place of potential exchange and collaboration, awaiting the arrival of ideas and voices. The second scene, full of vibrant colors and dedicated to research and development, draws me in with its promise of innovation and discovery. I feel inspired by the architecture of thought around me—spaces shaped for learning, sharing, and growing. Here, possibility seems to hum just beneath the surface.
